schemes.official_name: Work-Based Learning: Team Projects with Employer Partners
schemes.english_name: Work-Based Learning: Team Projects with Employer Partners
schemes.description: Level 2 credit-bearing course in which students apply for a preferred sponsored project, are interviewed, and then work in teams on a real project for a sponsoring organisation: a team project plan is sent to the sponsor for sign-off or changes, the team produces a group report, and a pre-recorded pitch is shown to the class and the project sponsors at the end. Projects must add value for the sponsor and link to at least one University 2040 theme (sustainability, internationalisation, inclusion). Individual project application and reflective reports are also assessed.
schemes.admin_host: Professional Development (catalogue subject); Careers and Employability lists it among curricular work-experience courses
schemes.eligibility_restrictions: Prerequisites listed as Programme Level 2 and Any Undergraduate Programme; entry via project application and interview
schemes.credit_assessment: 15 SCQF credits (7.5 ECTS); Achieved/Not Achieved. Components: application 5%, interview 5%, pre-project reflective report 5%, reflective test 5%, draft project plan signed off by sponsor 5%, final team plan 5%, milestone check-in 10%, pitch 10% (description says 15%), group report 40%, end reflective report 10% (sum 100%).
schemes.delivery_format: Aberdeen campus; team project with sponsor contact
schemes.project_evidence: A defined sponsored project run from application through project plan and milestones to a group report and pitch [1][2].
schemes.group_evidence: Course title and catalogue describe working in a team on a real project, with a team project plan and final team submission/group report [1][2].
schemes.employer_evidence: Each project has a sponsoring organisation: students work directly with the project sponsor and get feedback; the draft plan goes to the sponsor for sign-off; the final pitch is shown to the project sponsors; projects must add value for the sponsor [1][2].
schemes.partner_role: Project sponsor: sets the project, signs off the plan, gives feedback, receives the pitch
schemes.deliverable: Team project plan, group report, pre-recorded pitch to sponsors
schemes.participation_data: 23 undergraduates from a range of disciplines enrolled when the course launched in January 2025 (staff blog) [3]
schemes.unresolved: Fetched catalogue page is headed Academic session 2024-2025 (URL path /2025/); no 2025/26 or 2026/27 delivery evidence, so status is unclear. Partner sectors and named sponsors not published on the page.

profile_md:
Aberdeen has a small set of curricular routes where students work in teams on projects for outside organisations; none is verified as current for 2025/26 or later except ED251A and ED3537 (catalogue entries).

- **PD2503 Work-Based Learning: Team Projects with Employer Partners** (Level 2, 15 credits, any undergraduate discipline). Students apply and are interviewed, then work in a team on a live project: the draft plan is signed off by the sponsor, with a group report (40%) and a pitch. The page fetched is headed 2024-2025; 23 students enrolled at the January 2025 launch. Delivery after that is not confirmed.
- **ED251A Engineering Work Experience** (2025/26 catalogue, 15 credits): group consultancy project for a local engineering organisation, assessed by group report and group presentation; open to Level 2 students with Engineering studied.
- **ED3537 Employer-led Interdisciplinary Project** (2025/26 catalogue, 30 credits, Level 3/4, any undergraduate programme): small-group consultancy-style project; the host-organisation role is not shown on the 2025/26 page, so employer connection is Unclear.
- **ED3536 Working Together** (Arts & Social Sciences, group project from a local business or charity): evidenced only in a 2018-19 case study.

Computing Science's Year 4 work-based course appears to be one student per employer project (not group). The Grad Challenge (extracurricular, virtual employer-set challenges) could not be verified. Business, science, and law/health searches found no qualifying current group-client route. Provision is distributed across routes, not an institution-wide requirement.
gaps: Current (2025/26-2026/27) delivery of PD2503 and ED3536 not confirmed; sponsor sectors/named partners not published on the pages read; ED251A compulsory status unknown; ED3537 host role on current page not shown; Grad Challenge page 404; ABDN Internships seven-week employer-project strand unverified; Business School, science, law and health yielded no verified current group-client routes (reduced-depth, ~8 searches/fetches in this resume). Further departmental instances likely.
